{{main|1989–90 Copa del Rey}}
The '''1990 Copa del Rey final''' was the 88th final of the [[Copa del Rey|King's Cup]]. The final was played at [[Mestalla Stadium]] in [[Valencia]] on 5 April 1990, and was won by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], who beat [[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]] 2–0.

{{clear}}
